We really wanted to like this place..
May 2023 • Couples
We went to this restaurant expecting an amazing experience. The staff were helpful and the crackling pork with green curry paste was amazing. The atmosphere was quiet and subdued which was a nice change from the bustle of the street. However the catfish with mango salad was underwhelming and the traditional Thai noodles were not very appetizing due to the offal and soup broth with the noodles. And the final bill was extra large due to the holiday with an additional 25% charge (5% tax, 10% gratuity, 10% holiday gratuity) on top of the bill. We really wanted to like this place, but unfortunately first impressions are the lasting ones. Maybe we just ordered the wrong dishes..?

A surprise worth finding
Mar 2023 • Friends
This place I had walked past at least a dozen times, it is near the hotel we were staying at and one night another couple and ourselves were just going to walk down the street to find somewhere to eat for dinner.
I stopped in front of the restaurant which from looking in the front window looked empty, but we went inside anyway.
Escorted down a set of railway tracks to the main eating area, which was almost full of people.
Our party was 4 people, we ordered 4 starters and 4 mains, some drinks and after a short wait the food started to arrive.
Wonderful.
that is all I can really say, wonderful.

The service was great, the seafood was great, the variety and choice were great, and the bill was surprising, it did not cost what we thought, far cheaper.

We left HCMC the next day, so unfortunately we did not have a chance to go again.

BEST OF THAILAND IN VIETNAM
Aug 2022
Superb!! Best Thai cuisine tasted ever in Ho Chi Minh. The staff were courteous,helpful and welcoming especially their Operations Director Willie. I personally enjoy most of the food on the menu. The staff there are also very quick and efficient.Price is relatively reasonable, if you combine all the factors, such as location of the restaurant, speed of serving, portion of the serving, this is a decent place to have a good meal. The tastes and flavours are superb. . Loved the creamy Tom Yum Soup , Fried Fish with Mango Salad Dressing and the Durian sticky rice dessert! Definitely the best place to visit if you are having thai food cravings.
